maintenance_led.reason: Sells usage-based cloud compute, inference, databases and app hosting to developers; not repair or replacement of installed equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are developers, startups and businesses paying for cloud, AI inference and hosting services; not government-funded.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling more cloud and AI services; only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Hosts production apps, databases and AI agents; migrating workloads, data and infrastructure causes real switching cost and downtime risk.
